text: *ST数源公告，公司此前于2026年4月22日因涉嫌信息披露违法违规收到中国证监会《立案告知书》；2026年9月9日，公司及相关当事人收到浙江证监局《行政处罚事先告知书》。浙江证监局调查完毕，拟对公司责令改正、给予警告并处以800万元罚款，对章国经等6人分别处以400万元、200万元、100万元、80万元、60万元、50万元罚款，并拟对章国经采取8年证券市场禁入措施。
text_en: *ST Suyuan announced it received a case filing notice from the CSRC on April 22, 2026, for suspected information disclosure violations. On September 9, 2026, the company and related parties received an advance penalty notice from the Zhejiang Regulatory Bureau. The bureau concluded its investigation and plans to order corrections, issue warnings, and fine the company 8 million yuan; six individuals including Zhang Guojing face fines of 4 million, 2 million, 1 million, 800,000, 600,000, and 500,000 yuan respectively, with Zhang Guojing also facing an 8-year market ban.
